title: Area 7 · Twin pools

sourceRecords.title: Area 7 · Twin pools
read: Two dark pools fill much of the cavern. Water presses against rough stone-and-timber dams. The waterfall’s echo makes quieter movement hard to place.

The rough barriers hold back a great deal of water, and the noise fills the space around them. You can inspect their visible supports, look for ground that stays out of the current, or study the onward route before putting someone beside a dam.

brief: Cragmaw twin-pools cavern, TWO large natural pools held by LOW FIELDSTONE DAMS, narrow waterfall high in EAST wall feeds them, stream drains WEST. Wide SOUTH exit and TWO smaller west passages. THREE goblin guards if discovered, otherwise neutral pool view. No modern aqueduct, enormous underground ocean or glowing waters. Off-frame visitor light plus dim natural reflected water.
